# Partition-Ratio Frontier Long Run

## Scope and stop conditions

This run attacks the first two open nodes after Stages 19--22: normalized
local comparison and state-weighted complement control.  It stops before
claiming basin entry unless a complete nonlinear finite-volume `SU(2)` kernel
bound is uniform in volume and retained state.  It stops before claiming any
continuum or mass-gap result unless RG iteration, cutoff removal,
Osterwalder--Schrader reconstruction, and observable density are separately
proved.

- [x] Test finite normalization and invalid inputs.
- [x] Separate centered-reference closure from boundary-uniform closure.

- [x] Compile, render, and inspect the four theorem reports.

## Claim ceiling

The expected maximum is `C2`: exact abstract/finite theorems and executable
finite calibrations.  A failure to prove the uniform physical partition-ratio
inequality is a valid terminal result of this run.
